tagline: Block-by-block heat and air quality, calibrated and open.
map-hint: A schematic map of sensor cells. Each marker states its reading in text; the same data is in the Table and List tabs for any reader the map does not serve.
provisional: Cells marked provisional have only uncalibrated readings and are shown as not-yet-confirmed, never as fact. Category is conveyed by text and pattern, not color alone.
footer-data: Observations are public domain (CC0-1.0); see DATA-LICENSE. Download the full history from /export.csv — no account, no key.
footer-note: Each reading carries its calibration state and, when calibrated, a published uncertainty. This page reports what the air and heat readings are; it does not tell anyone they are safe. See docs/calibration.md.
no-data: No data yet. Run `swelter demo --serve` or `make demo`.
